# Canonical AI Assets

This folder is the source of truth. Tool adapters (`.claude/`, `.cursor/`, `.github/agents/`, ...) are generated from it with `node .ai/cli/bin/cli.mjs sync`.

- `skills/`: one reusable step each (see `skills/README.md`).
- `roles/`: four owners, one per ticket type: architect, builder, reviewer, qa. Domain checklists in `roles/playbooks/`.
- `workflows/`: how the skills chain from idea to release.
- `tools/`: context, verification, adapter and MCP policies.

Rules:

- Edit here, then sync. Never edit generated adapters.
- To own a generated file, delete its `Generated by engr-toolbox` header line; sync will then leave it alone.
- Portable files here contain no project-specific paths. Those belong in `AGENTS.md`, `docs/` and `.ai/maps/`.
